Elena Park: morning! quick onboarding question  where do people stash a private ramp journal vs the canonical team docs? also who should I ping to get edit rights on the 'Feature Launch Checklist' template? @Marcus @DocOps
Marcus Liu: hey Elena, welcome! Private stuff -> My Workspace. Canonical docs live in Company Wiki > Docs Library > Teams > Product > Onboarding. If you want others to follow along, move the page into Team Space > New Hires.
Ruth Bell: templates are in Company Wiki > Templates > New Hire Toolkit. The template header shows Owner: <team/person>. If owner looks stale, tag @TeamDocs in a page comment or use the quick request.
Elena Park: is there a shorthand to request edit access from Slack? trying to avoid filling the form while setting up monitors
Marcus Liu: yes, two flows: quick Slack snippet for urgent/temporary needs, or the formal form for audit. Quick example (paste in #devex):
```
@DocOps request-edit --page "https://notion.redwood.company/Company/Templates/Product/Feature-Launch-Checklist" --reason "tailor for kickoff process" --perm comment
```
That creates a ticket and pings the docs rotation.
OnboardBot: Auto: ticket DOC-14112 created for Elena Park -> Feature-Launch-Checklist. Permission requested: comment. Assigned: Product Docs. ETA: 24h.
Elena Park: perfect, filed it. small follow-up: if I duplicate and customize locally, what's the best way to propose changes back to the canonical template?
Ruth Bell: duplicate into your workspace, add a short "Proposed changes" section at the top listing bullet diffs, then comment on the source template with the link + summary and tag the owner. If it's a small tweak owners can merge; bigger ones may go through docs review.
Marcus Liu: pro tip: keep a tiny banner at top of your fork: "Forked from Feature-Launch-Checklist v2.0 - do not edit source" and include the canonical link. Saves confusion later.
Elena Park: one last thing  manager wants a 30/60/90 template; which one do we use for PMs?
Ruth Bell: Templates > New Hire Toolkit > PM 30-60-90. Duplicate and rename "Elena Park - 30/60/90" and share with your manager. If you want me to add your manager as editor, say so and I'll add them after the ticket clears. :wave:
